block_cache_late_init_safety: CPU full logical block-cache owner is zero-filled; GPU slots copy from CPU owner before any slot-backed cache-hit read
block_cache_slot_rotation_initial_m_rati: m=8 is the default because the canonical 120K/batch8/cache_ratio=0.05 geometry uses about 186 MiB per layer; eight slots cost about 1.45 GiB and give a seven-layer prefetch lead, the smallest planned lead likely to hide a full-layer PCIe H2D copy.
